explanation: Close encounter of the two heavy bodies (0 and 1, m~17 and 18) with G~4.73. Distance drops to ~1.45 at step 9 while acceleration is large. Leapfrog substep count (10-11 per outer dt=0.0176) is insufficient to integrate the stiff softened gravity accurately; pairwise forces become asymmetric over the substeps, injecting net momentum. Halving dt removes the error and restores conservation.
vision_note: Steps 6-8 show two larger blue bodies in close proximity near the top-center drifting slowly together with a small third body isolated on the left. At the violating step 9 there is no visible jump, wall contact, or abrupt displacement – the configuration remains nearly static with only a faint velocity trail on the right-hand body.
